sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Link previews: every box stacked above a hover card now opens with a kind line and a thin line under it, as the card does since WIP.1: "Finding", "Note", "Track ≠ recording", "Link title", "Link" (a link's own card, a Relationships icon) or "Filter".

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Release tracklist: hovering a live track's "#" cell now also shows the event the track was recorded at, in a card stacked right above the release group card: its name, type, date, place, tour, line-up and the start of its setlist, as the event link's own preview shows them. With the kind line of WIP.1, the two cards read "Event" and "Release group". The first hover on a track of an event asks MusicBrainz once, after the release group search and at the same one-a-second pace; the answer is kept like the other previews. A track whose event is only named in its comment shows no event card. New setting "Show the track's event above the "#" release group card" (💿 RELEASE TRACKLIST), on by default.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Link previews: every hover card now opens with a kind line, the entity's icon and its kind ("Recording", "Release group", "Event"), the same words as the window's title bar, so the card says what Space will open. Cards of other sites get it too ("Discogs release", "Wikipedia"), without an icon. The icon moved out of the title into that line; the loading and failed cards no longer repeat the kind under the title.
The release page's release-group cards (the subheader link and the "#" cell of a live track) now carry MusicBrainz's release-group icon, in the card and in the window's title bar.
